headerDisplay: Exposes Brilliant panels to HomeKit through the brilliant-mqtt on-panel agent. Install the agent on each panel first with the bundled `brilliant-homebridge install` command — see the plugin README.

url.title: Broker URL
url.description: The broker the panels publish to, as reachable from Homebridge. Use mqtts:// for TLS.

caFile.title: CA certificate file
caFile.description: PEM file for a private broker CA (mqtts:// only).

panelControls.title: Panel settings
panelControls.description: Screen, volume, mic mute, night mode, child lock, screensaver… as switches and sliders (about 15 per panel).

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Load/CPU temperatures, fault, Wi-Fi/internet/NTP status, camera-active.

power.title: Power (W)
power.description: Per-circuit wattage as an Eve characteristic. Visible in Eve / Controller for HomeKit, not in Apple's Home app.

scenes.title: Brilliant scenes and modes
scenes.description: Momentary switches that run a panel's Brilliant scenes. Requires the scene bridge on the agent (the installer enables it by default).

disabledByDefault.title: Advanced tuning entities
disabledByDefault.description: Entities the agent marks disabled-by-default: motion thresholds, lock-screen widgets, firmware auto-update, remote assistance…

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Hide entities whose name or id matches. * is a wildcard, e.g. "*Temperature" or "brilliant_office_*volume*".

panels.title: Only these panels
panels.description: Panel names (as given to the installer) to include. Empty = all. The BLE-mesh devices are the panel "mesh".

oneOf.title: Fan speed (not affected by "turn off the lights")

pruneStale.title: Remove accessories missing from the broker
pruneStale.description: Off by default: an accessory is only removed when the agent explicitly retires it. Turning this on also removes accessories whenever the broker loses its retained messages, which discards their HomeKit rooms and automations.
